name: Dan Khailo
bio:
I’m originally from Ukraine, and Hawaiʻi is now my home.

I’ve always been driven to follow my own path. My confidence grew through experience—taking chances, learning difficult lessons, and discovering my own worth. Along the way, I developed a deep interest in human psychology, body language, eye contact, and the ways men and women connect.

Helping people build confidence has always mattered to me. But over the years, I watched friends go through divorce and lose their sense of who they were. Men I knew to be capable and caring began to withdraw, doubt themselves, and struggle to find a way forward.

That’s why I created Primal Reset.

One of my hardest lessons has been learning to give to others without forgetting myself. I’m still working on that balance every day. I believe that learning to love and respect yourself helps you build healthier, more meaningful relationships with others.

My approach is direct, honest, and respectful. I speak openly, and I love bringing humor into difficult moments—without making anyone the target.

To me, brotherhood means having other men you can turn to for support. Being vulnerable with another man can feel uncomfortable. Talking openly about heartbreak, fear, or uncertainty takes courage. I want this retreat to be a place where those conversations are welcomed.

Primal Reset brings together men navigating divorce, heartbreak, and significant life changes. Through supportive role-play, honest feedback, one-to-one coaching, movement, and shared experiences, we create opportunities to reconnect with ourselves and with others.

You’ll practice communicating more openly, explore how you relate to women, and build connections with men who understand what you’re going through. Physical activities offer another way to challenge yourself and discover new strengths, with participation always optional.

I love training and helping people get back on their feet. For me, caring for the body is an important part of caring for the mind.

My mission is simple: to help men rebuild their confidence, recognize their worth, and become more present in their own lives.
quote: You don’t chase what you want. You attract what you become.
